summary: App customization and rewards features: profile photo frame overlay, badge display on profile, purchasable themes as app backgrounds, adjustable Pomodoro study/break timers, and a coin-priced streak-freezer item.

existing_features.title: Change the Streak Freeze price to 50 coins everywhere it is enforced and displayed (backend purchase validation and all frontend UI text).

Update the Profile avatar rendering so that when a user has an unlocked/selected frame, the frame visually overlays and covers the circumference of the profile photo (a ring/frame sitting on top of the circular avatar edge, not behind it).
Display purchased/earned badges on the user profile, including badges earned via streak milestones and badges purchased with coins.
Make purchased themes apply as the app background (global app background), using the user's currently selected purchased theme.

new_feature_requests.summary: Profile frame: when unlocked, the frame should cover/overlay the circumference of the profile photo.
Display purchased badges (earned by streak and/or bought with coins) on the user profile.
Use purchased themes as the app background.
Allow changing Pomodoro study timer and break timer durations.

projectName: Profile cosmetics: frame overlay, badge display, theme backgrounds + set streak freezer cost to 50 coins
